title: LRU Response Cache with Immutable Keys and Transactions
instructions: Implement `PromptKey`, `ResponseCache` and `CacheTransaction` in `cache.py`. `PromptKey` is an immutable, hashable key that owns a frozen copy of its messages. `ResponseCache` is a bounded LRU `MutableMapping` that implements only the five abstract methods. `cache.transaction()` buffers writes, commits them on a clean exit, discards them on error and never swallows exceptions.

evidence.label: Equal keys hash equal regardless of dict key order
A key is isolated from later mutation of the caller's data
A key is immutable and compares politely with other types
Least recently used key is evicted; reads refresh recency
Overwriting a key refreshes it without evicting
get, pop, update and items are inherited from MutableMapping
A transaction buffers writes and commits on success
A transaction discards writes on error and does not swallow it
